entities.summary: Ramathipadi I, also known as Ponhea Chan, Cau Bana Cand, Botum Reachea I, Nac Cham, or Sultan Ibrahim, reigning from 1642 to 1658, was the first and only Cambodian king to convert to Islam. Ramathipadi I was the third son of Chey Chettha II.
